title.narrative: SENEGAL - Project for the Improvement of Education System Performance - PAPSE

description.narrative: The Development Objective is to improve quality, equity, and access in the education sector.

The proposed project is expected to quality, equity, and access through the following critical interventions: (i) support to foundational learning in national languages in select regions in Senegal; (ii) reform of curriculum, and integration of improved learning modules for pre-service training at the Centre Regional de Formation des Personnels de l’Education (CRFPEs); (iii) increasing access for out-of-school children and vulnerable populations with the inclusion of a national digitally enabled access intervention that will offer a blended learning approach through a mix of virtual and face to face instruction, (iv) support to daaras through performance based contracts which support foundational learning and improved learning conditions, and (vi) supporting good governance practices through support to inspection interne, approaches to better managing partner financing, and support to a teacher deployment strategy for hardship regions. The Project's direct beneficiaries include present and future students in primary education who will benefit from a better quality education focused on equipping them with basic foundational learning skills; as well as current and future students enrolled in the CRFPEs, and students enrolled in the LYNAQEs (high schools of excellence). The proposed Project will also benefit teachers by professionalizing and investing in their continuous professional development. Through the digitally enabled access intervention, the proposed Project will benefit out-of-children to give them a second chance education, as well as children enrolled in daaras. Administrators at regional, district and school levels will also benefit.

condition.narrative: A GBV consultant will be recruited within 90 days of project effectiveness date, for a minimum of 18 months, and renewablethereafter as needed

An external auditor with qualifications satisfactory to the World Bank will be recruited or assigned within six months ofeffectiveness to conduct annual audits of the project financial statements in accordance with audit ToR agreed upon with the WorldBank.

An organizational structure including an Environmental Safeguard Specialist (ESS) and a Social Development and Gender Specialist(SDS) shall be recruited within 90 days of the effectiveness date, and retained throughout the project cycle.

No later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, and no later than and September 30 of each subsequent year, the Recipientshall prepare and furnish to the Association a draft annual work plan for review and comment, summarizing the Project activities(including, among others, Incremental Operating Costs and Training) to be undertaken in the following fiscal year (together withdocumentary evidence that the safeguard obligations related to such upcoming Project activities shall be fully complied with in atimely fashion in accordance with the requirements including or referred to in the ESCP), including the proposed annual budget andsources of financing for the Project, and a summary of the activities completed during the previous year of Project implementation(if any).(FA, Schedule 2, Section I.D.1).

No later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall establish and thereafter maintain, throughout theperiod of implementation of the Project, a unit (“Project Management Unit”) with mandate and composition satisfactory to theAssociation. (FA, Schedule 2, Section 1.A.2 (a))

No later than two (2) months after the Effective Date (or such other date which the Association has confirmed in writing to theRecipient is reasonable and acceptable under the circumstances, as determined by Association in its sole discretion), the Recipientshall prepare and adopt a manual of procedures for the implementation of the Project (the “Manual of Administrative, Financial,Accounting and Technical Procedures”) in form and substance acceptable to the Association. (FA, Schedule 2, Section 1.C.1)

No later than two months after effectiveness date, the Recipient shall establish under its ministry responsible for education andthereafter maintain throughout the period of implementation of the Project, a Project Steering Committee with a mandate andcomposition satisfactory to the Association, for the purpose of, among other things, providing overall policy and strategicguidance for the Project implementation, ensuring inter-ministerial coordination, leadership and approval of annual work plans andbudgets. (FA, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1(a)).
